## Tastemakers Collective (https://www.tastemakerscollective.us/)

TASTEMAKERSCOLLECTIVECatering and events in Los Angeles Custom menus for every event and every diet. Duck Tacos · Panang Beef Barbacoa · Lobster Tortelloni · Crispy Maitake Tacos · Chateaubriand Who we are A Los Angeles catering and events company. We cook for offices, weddings, private parties, productions on set and music festivals. Our specialty is food for people with dietary restrictions, cooked from whole foods. Vegan, gluten free and dairy free options are on every menu, every dish is labeled, and chicken and beef are halal. Our kitchen is led by a chef with seventeen years in fine dining kitchens and more than a decade cooking for artist hospitality and crews at music festivals. ## About Tastemakers Collective (https://www.tastemakerscollective.us/about)

About About Tastemakers Collective Tastemakers Collective is a Los Angeles catering and events company. Custom menus for every event and every diet. What we do Catering Custom menus cooked and served at your event. Drop-off Boxed meals and pans delivered ready to serve. On set Crew breakfast and lunch delivered to location. Events Corporate events, private parties and celebrations. Festival vending Food vending, staff meals and artist hospitality. Bar service Bartenders and house-made mixers. You supply the alcohol. Pop-ups One-night events we run ourselves. Supper clubs Private dinners announced to our guest list. Who we are Tastemakers Collective is a chef-driven catering, events and food vending company in Los Angeles. Our specialty is food for people with dietary restrictions, cooked from whole foods. Our kitchen is led by a chef with seventeen years in fine dining kitchens in California and more than a decade cooking for artist hospitality, green rooms and crews at music festivals. We cook from a permitted commercial kitchen in Los Angeles. Credentials Permitted by LA County Public Health ServSafe certified manager $2M general liability insurance, certificate available on request Licensed California LLC Where we work Los Angeles and Southern California, plus festivals across California. Contact Work with us. Book → Permitted by LA County Public Health. Prepared in a permitted commercial kitchen. $2M general liability insurance. ServSafe certified manager. Certificate of insurance available on request.

## Contact Tastemakers Collective (https://www.tastemakerscollective.us/contact)

Contact Contact Tastemakers Collective Tell us about your event and we’ll get back to you. Serving Los Angeles and Southern California. Email hello@tastemakerscollective.us Call or text (213) 293-8518 Contact Name Email Phone Additional notes The event Event typeWeddingCorporate eventPrivate partyCelebrationFestival or event vendingProduction or on setOther Service stylePlated cateringBuffet cateringFamily style cateringAction stationsDrop-off cateringVendingDry hire barNot sure yet Expected attendance Load-in and service hours Power and water on siteYesNoNot sure Date Location Guest countUnder 2525 to 5050 to 100100 to 200200 to 500More than 500 Details Dietary needs and allergies Budget (optional) Send inquiry Frequently asked questions How does booking work? Send an inquiry with the date, the place, the guest count and any dietary needs. We reply with a custom menu and a quote. The menu and consultation are free. How does the deposit work? A 50% deposit holds the date. Events booked on short notice are paid in full at signing. Do you offer tastings? A tasting is available once a wedding is booked. Can you handle dietary restrictions and allergies? That is our specialty. Vegan, gluten free and dairy free options are on every menu, every dish is labeled for dietary needs and allergens, and chicken and beef are halal. How does drop-off work? Boxed meals or pans, delivered ready to serve. Send a request on the Order page at least 48 hours ahead. Do you deliver plated food? No. Nothing plated or assembled is delivered. Boards and spreads are built on site by our staff. Do you offer bar service? Yes, as an add-on. We provide bartenders and house-made mixers; you supply the alcohol from a shopping list we give you. Where do you work? Los Angeles and Southern California, plus festivals across California. Can you provide a certificate of insurance? Yes. We carry $2M general liability insurance and the certificate can name your event or production as additional insured. Permitted by LA County Public Health.
